text:
ryan: Heads-up — intermittent switch-fabric packet drops in us-west3 hitting GPU racks 3-5. Planning a maintenance window tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC to apply NIC firmware + switch OS patch. Need ops + customer-comm sign-off.
maya: Saw this earlier — training jobs saw repeated retransmits, a few pods evicted, hosted inference tail latency up ~5% for ~20m. Not widespread but risky for big batches.
samir: Which racks exactly? Any MCUs/firmware versions we target? Need a clear runbook.
ryan: Target racks: usw3-rack-03, -04, -05. NICs: mlx5 rev 2.1 -> 2.3 firmware. Switch OS patch: 12.7.2 -> 12.7.5. Steps: stagger per-rack cordon/drain, 15m canary on rack-03, then sequentials. Warmup KV caches after each drain.
lucas: +1 on canary. Suggest running a small podset sending 128-token requests to verify tail p95 before moving to next rack.
ryan: Runbook (short):
```bash
# cordon
kubectl cordon node-usw3-rack03-01
# drain with grace and evict local cache-safe pods
kubectl drain node-usw3-rack03-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120
# apply NIC fw and reboot
ssh root@bmc-rack03-01 'fwupdmgr install /tmp/mlx5-2.3.bin && reboot'
# post-checks
kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=node-usw3-rack03-01
# run canary load
./scripts/loadtest --region=us-west3 --qps=50 --tokens=128
```
maya: For drains, prefer --pod-selector to avoid kicking long-running matrix-train jobs; we'll fallback to reserved pool for those. Also set autoscaler to hold extra warm nodes for 20m.
ops-oncall: I'm on for 01:30-04:30 UTC window. I'll be oncall channel and watching netflow and eviction metrics.
elaine: Customer comms: notify Dedicated customers in us-west3 with 1h notice, status page incident during window, mention rolling nature and expected minimal disruption. For Hosted, post brief note if we see >2% error spike.
samir: Cost note: keeping 4 extra warm reserved GPUs for backfill ~ est $110/hr. If we reduce spot usage during window we can avoid spikes but extra reserved is safer.
devops-bot: alert: net.packet_drop_percent(us-west3) spiking to 0.9% at 2026-03-19T23:48:12Z — affected pods 12, evictions 3 :warning:
ryan: We'll gate canary by: p95 latency within 10% of baseline AND packet_drop < 0.2% for 10m. If fail, rollback NIC fw and re-schedule.
lucas: Rollback steps documented — keep fw binary cached on BMCs for fast revert.
maya: Also add a prefix-cache flush and warmup step: after node rejoin, run KV warmup script to populate top-10 prefixes for common customers.
elaine: I'll draft the status page blurb and ping legal for SLA wording for Dedicated customers.
ops-oncall: Add me as watcher on the scheduled change in PagerDuty and create a post-mortem template in advance.
ryan: Thanks. I'll own the runbook and be in #eng-oncall for the window. Starting preflight at 01:00 UTC to validate backups and BMC reachability. :thumbsup:
samir: LGTM. Please add the exact kubectl drain flags and the autoscaler hold commands to the runbook before preflight.
elaine: Communication plan agreed. I'll send the notice 1h before the window and update if canary passes/fails.
ryan: Final: maintenance window tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC, staggered per-rack, canary on rack-03. If anything unexpected, abort and reopen incident channel.
